title: Bhagavatapurana, book 9
source: sa_bhAgavatapurANa.txt; GRETIL (gretil.sub.uni-goettingen.de), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (data entry: Ulrich Stiehl)
reply:
These verses name no kinship or succession relations. They narrate and praise Kṛṣṇa (Madhusūdana), his deeds, and the peoples he pleased. Two things I did not count:

- Verse 63 names clans in a list (Bhoja, Vṛṣṇi, Andhaka, Madhu, Śūrasena, Daśārha, Kuru, Sṛñjaya, Pāṇḍu). It only says they praised him, and it does not say any line is named after a person.
- Verse 67 mentions Uddhava as the one Kṛṣṇa addressed, which is not a kinship statement.
